items.name: Lunar occultation of Antares
items.title: 06 Apr 2026 (Tomorrow): Lunar occultation of Antares
items.summary: The Moon will pass in front of Antares (Alpha Scorpii), creating a lunar occultation visible from countries and territories including Antarctica, Madagascar, French Southern Territories and Mauritius amongst others.
items.note: Event highlight. Low but possible (11° max). Best around 04:10.
